execution._note: AS FOR THE CORE, PAPER ONLY: the recorded exception to CLAUDE.md order-path rule 3 (team lead, 2026-09-29), which the rule itself scopes to the paper account. Alpaca paper runs no closing auction and under-fills cls (11 of 13 expired on 2026-09-29), so the plan is DECIDED in the evening (morning backstop) and SENT as market day orders 8 to 2 minutes before the calendar close (15:52-15:58 ET; 12:52-12:58 on a 13:00 early close). Verify scores every fill against the official closing print. The window equals the core's because the installer's timers (15:52 and 15:55, 12:52 and 12:55) and its late-window guards are derived from it (quantt/deploy/install_vm.py, PLAN_REFUSE_RANGES_ET / RESTART_REFUSE_RANGES_ET pin the core's window). bp_shortfall 'scale' is the core's ruling of 2026-10-07 (every opening order scaled by one factor when the decided plan does not fit Alpaca's buying power; run.fit_to_buying_power). REVERT: delete this block (cls, refuse). NEVER for a live-money account.

data._missing_nav_note: AS FOR THE CORE (team lead 2026-10-29): gate 5's missing-NAV hold, quantt/session/gate.py missing_nav_hold. A fund whose only fault is a NAV not dated the as-of date DEFERS the decide before the final check (close - 90 min, 14:30 ET) and from the final check is HELD at its current shares, out of the cross-section, while the others decide. AGE LIMIT 2 consecutive sessions, the team lead's POLICY for the core, carried, not derived for C4: after it the day is refused, naming the fund. The name limit is derived by the runner from the C4 spec's min_names (74 - 6 = 68). Why it matters more here: C4's NAVs come from yfinance alone (no CEFConnect, below), so a late NAV is never filled from a second source; fetch_daily --data-book c4 exits 4 and the hold is what keeps one late fund from costing the other 73 the day. STILL REFUSED: a missing or stale close, a fund with no NAV at all, any refresh failure other than exit 4 (including exit 6, the spike guard: an unruled spike-and-revert bar in the fetched window), and more missing NAVs than 68. READ BY quantt/session/run.py missing_nav_for and missing_nav_max_sessions_for. NO data.stale_nav ON PURPOSE: the stale-NAV gate reads CEFConnect, which is disabled for C4 (team lead 2026-10-28, plan section 3 item 3), and locks and logs as the core's fetch_daily; run.stale_nav_panel refuses it for any NAV file but the core's. C4's defence against a stale NAV is the spec's NAV-repeat mask M1 (frozen.nav_repeat_mask), and the collector reports each fund-day M1 removes (quantt/collect BOOKS['c4'] step nav_repeats). REVERT: delete these three keys and the block (gate 5 then refuses the day on one missing NAV).

risk._drawdown_note: REPORT MODE, as for the core (team lead 2026-10-19): at every decide the runner measures the book's drawdown from its high-water mark on <state>/eod_equity.csv (Alpaca's end-of-day portfolio history for C4's own account, the official daily P&L, written by quantt/collect --book c4 from the installer's eod_from) and compares it with the FROZEN SPEC's risk.halve_drawdown and risk.kill_drawdown (quantt/session/drawdown.py). Nothing that trades reads the result. THE LEVELS ARE THE SPEC'S, AND THE C4 SPEC NAMES NONE, ON PURPOSE (its risk._drawdown_levels_note): C4's stop rule is the spec's kill_rule (H11, PREREG_C4 section 14): HALT on a fidelity break; REVERSE at 120 armed sessions below the 5th percentile of the 1.90 spec book's 120-session price-only returns, or at any time on a drawdown past that book's fit worst, each RE-MEASURED on its read date by scripts/cef/c4_paper_benchmark.py (H14: no threshold is written in a document), and the core's 0.12 / 0.18 were set for another book. So report mode records UNMEASURED naming the missing levels at every decide, which is the truth and never blocks. The team lead's 2026-10-29 ruling left the halve/kill levels for this file to decide; it decides NONE here, because the runner reads levels only from the spec, a number written here would be read by nothing, and one written in the spec needs a derivation and a new spec id (/spec-change). OPEN for the team lead before arming (results/ops/C4_DRY_RUN_CHECKLIST_2026-10-29.md). READ BY quantt/session/run.py drawdown_for and _drawdown. REVERT: delete this block (no check).

corporate_actions._note: AS FOR THE CORE: the team lead's 2026-10-28 ruling is a HALT guard 'for the paper runner', and C4 trades on the same paper runner. Alpaca paper processes no splits or mergers, so a held fund that splits keeps its old share count at the new price and the plan is sized on the wrong exposure; C4's own history has one (IGR's 1:3 reverse split, effective 2026-09-08, whose four post-split-basis bars the seed rules on). At every decide, and again at the late-market send, the runner reads Alpaca's non-dividend corporate actions for every held and targeted name and REFUSES the session (a gate-5 data refusal, exit 11) on one inside its window, or when the feed cannot be read (quantt/session/corp_actions.py; windows ruled 2026-10-29). The read is one market-wide query, filtered locally, so 74 names add no requests. A long-window halt on a held name clears only through docs/RUNBOOK.md section 6.1, orders through the team lead. Set here by the integration of 2026-10-29, not by a separate ruling for C4: REVERT to the session without the gate by deleting this block, or set 'report' to record and send anyway.
